name: A Moment of Quiet
idea: A centered invitation and generous arched room portrait make a small retreat within the page.
emotion: Warmth, calm and the feeling that this appointment has been made for you.
composition: A symmetrical cream gallery composition: two-line serif invitation above a large central arch, fine gold framing, and a low, spacious booking rail. Unlike the side-by-side Open Room and the split editorial headline of Entirely Yours.
motion: The arch opens upward, its gold contour follows, and the booking rail arrives last. Fully settled at 2.3 seconds.

name: The Open Room
idea: An expansive doorway into the real room meets a quiet, personal invitation.
emotion: An open welcome, an unhurried pace and the ease of being looked after.
composition: An oversized room portrait fills the left side, framed as a tall gold-edged doorway. A calm serif invitation and booking sit together on the right. On a phone the doorway comes first, unlike the title-first Moment of Quiet.
motion: The room is revealed upward into its arch, the photograph eases to rest, and the invitation appears in sequence. Fully settled at 2.2 seconds.

name: Entirely Yours · Studio
idea: A warm, clear view of the actual GLO studio fills the larger accepted photo frame.
emotion: Personal attention and room to breathe.
composition: Split serif headline above and below a larger centered photo of the real tan-chair studio, softened corners and a fine gold frame; no blurred side fill or extra image zoom. Phone shows the full square room photo.
motion: The frame opens horizontally, its gold contour follows, and the booking invitation rises gently.
